nativeZh: n. 成熟分裂, 减数分裂
[医] 减数分裂, 成熟分裂

senses.en: (genetics) cell division that produces reproductive cells in sexually reproducing organisms; the nucleus divides into four nuclei each containing half the chromosome number (leading to gametes in animals and spores in plants)
senses.zh: （遗传学）有性生殖生物产生生殖细胞的一种细胞分裂；细胞核分成四个核，每个所含染色体数减半，在动物中形成配子，在植物中形成孢子。

senses.en: understatement for rhetorical effect (especially when expressing an affirmative by negating its contrary)
senses.zh: 少说出言辞效果(特别是在通过否认相反表示肯定时)

examples.en: saying `I was not a little upset' when you mean `I was very upset' is an example of litotes
examples.zh: 说`我并没有一点不高兴',你说`我非常不高兴',就是用字写字的例子。
